title: PALMS OF DUNE ALLEN 108 | Dune Allen Beach, FL | Five Star Properties
meta_description: Palms of Dune Allen 108 - Vacation Rental in Dune Allen BeachFavorite Features:- Gulf-Front - Community Pool
description_expanded: Palms of Dune Allen 108 - Vacation Rental in Dune Allen Beach Favorite Features: - Gulf-Front  - Community Pool - Close Proximity to Shopping and Dining More About Palms of Dune Allen 108: Located on beautiful County Hwy 30A, this gulf-front condo with three bedrooms and three bathrooms offers accommodations for up to 8 guests! Take in striking gulf-views from the patio of this first-floor*, corner unit perfect for families or small groups. This beach community holds three coastal dune lakes, which are very rare and only found in a select few places around the world. Dune Allen on 30A is a paradise for any guest that loves nature and the beach, and this condo is in a prime spot to see it all.   A mirror panel wall, an open floor plan, and windows letting in natural light make the living area feel even larger and is a perfect spot for relaxation. The living room holds three sofa chairs and one large sofa. Off of the living area, guests will find a formal dining table to seat 6. Additional seating for two is available at the kitchen island. The kitchen is furnished with a coffee pot, blender, toaster oven, microwave, stove, oven, and refrigerator. Wood cabinetry, granite countertops, and an island for extra counter and dining space elevate the space for convenience and luxury.   The Master suite is adorned with plush furnishings and a king bed. The Master suite is accompanied by an en suite master bath with a stand-alone shower and dual sink vanity. A second bedroom provides two full beds to sleep four guests. A full bath across the hall is easily accessed guests of the second and third bedroom or the living area. The queen suite provides sleeping arrangements for two guests in a comfortable queen bed. *Although this is a first-floor unit, please note that there is a small set of stairs up to the front door (5 steps) and the unit is not wheelchair accessible. Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 2: 2 Full Beds & Shared Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. Bedroom 3: Queen Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo.
